description: The store listing (name, subtitle, descriptions, keywords, links, screenshots, App Store app previews with their processing state, Google Play's promo video) of both stores, per language: the app's languages with each store's code (Hebrew is he at Apple and iw-IL at Google), what each store is still missing per language, and for one language every field's live value, draft and character limit, and its screenshots and app previews in their order, each with the id ploa_screenshot_remove and ploa_preview_remove take and its set's setId for ploa_screenshot_order and ploa_preview_order. Videos are optional in both stores. Languages a store doesn't have yet can be added by writing drafts in that store's code and publishing.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

language.description: A language code (he, en-US, ja…); without it, the list of languages and what's missing.

name: ploa_listing_get
title: Read the store listing
